plan.change: Add a third interacting bug: the import idempotency check uses a composite key of (provider, amount_cents, merchant_id) instead of (provider, provider_transaction_id), so duplicate-amount transactions from the same merchant are silently dropped on re-import, causing balances to be understated. This means the solver must fix three interacting causes: (1) floating-point rounding in balance accumulation, (2) refund matching by provider_transaction_id instead of amount, and (3) the idempotency dedup key. Fixing any two of the three will pass some test cases but fail others. Update the environment so the ledger/__init__.py or db.py contains this third bug, and update the verifier to explicitly test a scenario with two same-amount charges to the same merchant from the same provider (one of which gets dropped under the broken dedup key), verifying the final balance reflects both charges.
plan.expected_effect: Agents that find and fix only the rounding and refund-matching bugs will still fail the idempotency test with duplicate-amount charges, reducing the pass rate to approximately 1-2 out of 5.
